ladder.label: UPTREND
ladder.why: The weekly (investor-cycle) momentum just crossed UP while price holds its 10-day average — the start of a new multi-month up-leg. A daily-overbought print here is the launch thrust, not a top, so this is a HOLD / ride, not a take-profit. The daily can still dip to its 10-day average (normal) — but the bigger investor cycle is early, with room left.
ladder.next: Hold / ride the fresh weekly up-leg; add on pullbacks toward the 10-day average rather than chasing the thrust. First warning would be the weekly momentum rolling back over.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum just crossed up (investor cycle week 8 · daily cycle day 35).
ladder.synthesis_line: Daily is hot (RSI 60, day 35/42 — a dip is normal soon), but the weekly investor cycle just turned up — so this is HOLD / ride a new up-leg, not take-profits.
ladder.synthesis_line_zh: 日线偏热（RSI 60，周期第 35 天——短期回调属正常），但周线投资者周期刚刚向上转向——因此应持有 / 顺势新上行段，而非止盈。
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: Trend intact — hold. Late in the cycle, so don't add here; a pullback is due.
entry.text_zh: 趋势完好——持有。已处周期晚期，此处不宜加仓；回调即将到来。

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 8 of a typical 16–26 weeks

cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 周线（投资者周期）动量刚刚向上交叉，且价格守住 10 日均线——这是新的多月上行段的起点。此处日线超买只是启动推力、并非见顶，因此应持有 / 顺势，而非止盈。日线仍可能回踩 10 日均线（属正常）——但更大的投资者周期尚处早期，仍有空间。
ladder.next_zh: 持有 / 顺应新的周线上行段；在回踩 10 日均线时加仓，而非追高推力。首个预警将是周线动量重新掉头向下。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉（投资者周期第 8 周 · 日线周期第 35 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：上涨趋势。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）

ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UPTREND signal just triggered today (fresh cross from BUY ZONE). Signal strength: moderate (score +60/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 上涨趋势信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自买入区翻转）。 信号强度：中等（评分 +60/100）。
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

quality.gloss: Business durability — will it survive the hold.
quality.gloss_zh: 业务的持久性——能否撑过持有期。

positioning.label: Positioning

macro.label: Macro exposure
macro.gloss: Rate / inflation sensitivity — context, never scored.

catalyst.label: Catalyst
catalyst.gloss: Next earnings date and any earnings/revision edge.
catalyst.gloss_zh: 下次财报日期与盈利／评级优势。
